scripts.dev:api: cd api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.dev:consumer: cd api && uv run python -m consumer
scripts.dev:celery: cd api && uv run celery -A app.core.celery_app worker --loglevel=info
scripts.dev:scheduler: cd worker && uv run python scheduler_main.py
scripts.dev:sync: cd worker && uv run python sync_main.py
